name: quic-drop
description: Any UDP datagram from the client that carries a QUIC v1 Initial (long header, version 1) is silently dropped, on every port. Other UDP is untouched, and so is TCP. A QUIC handshake can never start; an app's UDP inside a TCP tunnel is unaffected.
analogue: QUIC blocking by protocol rather than by port: Iran's QUIC/HTTP3 block of 22 September 2022 and the pre-blackout HTTP/3 collapse; the 2025 policy paper's 'immediate blocking of any simulated VPN connections such as QUIC'. Model: a stateless match on the QUIC invariant header (first nibble 0xC, version 0x00000001). It does NOT decrypt the Initial to read the SNI (the GFW's April 2024 QUIC-SNI blocking does; Daal's QUIC families send an IP-literal server name, so they carry no SNI to match), does not block QUIC v2, and an obfuscated QUIC (Hysteria2 salamander) would not match — Daal does not enable it.

nft: ip saddr $CLIENT_IP meta l4proto udp @th,64,4 0xc @th,72,32 0x00000001 drop
